Card Q&A.q: After suspending 1 of my opponent's Digimon with this card's [Main] effect, can I return some other Digimon than the one I suspended to the bottom of their deck?

Effect: When you would use this card, if you have 2 or more suspended green Digimon in play, reduce the cost by 2.
[Main] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck.
